rule: Reuse the four public adapted task types named in the P22 design; select all four before native capability qualification, without any new model outcomes. No replacements.

tasks.requirement: Two sets of n cars move in opposite directions on an infinite straight road. Every pair from opposite sets meets once; cars continue unchanged. Return the collision count. n is an integer in [0,10000].
Return the length of the input ASCII string s. Empty input has length zero. Inputs contain only ASCII characters and have length at most 64.
Return a new list with each integer from xs incremented by one, preserving order and duplicates. Empty input returns empty. At most 16 integers, each in [-1000,1000].

Starting with balance zero, apply the integer deposits/withdrawals xs in order. Return true if any running balance is negative, even if it later recovers; otherwise false. Empty input returns false. At most 16 integers, each in [-1000,1000].
